content.comment_body: I am unable to create a pulse button within the web editor; all the button functions I have tried are only hold functions. I want to use a pulse button to control, for example, a relay that is also activated by a pulse input. I hope someone can provide a solution to this. Regards, [user_name]
Hello [user_name], the official language of this international forum is English. Please post your questions in English. If you do not speak English, you may use a service such as Google Translator.

In the Web Editor, you cannot create a dynamic (pulse) signal; only static signals are possible. You need to manage pulse functionality within the [product_name] logic. Assign a bit in the variable memory area to the button (digital value in Web Editor), such as V0.0. In the [product_name], read this bit as a digital network input and connect it to the required function; at the same time, reset the bit by linking a digital network output to the same address and a LOW block. If you wish, I can provide an example.
Hi [user_name], sorry to respond to an old post, but I did not want to create another… Could you also share the LWE project?
The LWE project is included in the zip file mentioned earlier.

analysis.insight_summary: The user encounters difficulty adding a pulse button in the Web Editor, as available button types only support continuous actions. The product's web interface does not natively support dynamic (pulse) signal creation, requiring users to implement workarounds using variable memory bits and logic within the main module. This demonstrates a disconnect between the UI features and standard automation requirements, causing confusion and forcing users to rely on unofficial solutions.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects the Web Editor interface to allow configuration of a pulse-type button, enabling direct and simple control of digital inputs in the hardware module.
